topic: student and youth protests: Madrid's indefinite public-education strike (from 2026-10-14, students at Complutense and Rey Juan Carlos U in barricades and clashes) and Barcelona's youth 'Institut Indignats' gathering (2026-10-24)
scale: indefinite strike involving ~65,000 Madrid public-school teachers with student participation; ~600 young people at peak of the Barcelona gathering, ~100 detained
quote1: Una concentración de cerca de 600 jóvenes en el centro de Barcelona, convocada por redes sociales, ha derivado esta tarde en saqueos en 14 comercios, barricadas, quema de mobiliario urbano y enfrentamientos con Mossos, que han detenido un centenar de personas, una cuarta parte de ellos menores.
quote2: Students at the Universidad Rey Juan Carlos protested as Javier Milei arrived for an event with anarcho-capitalist economists.
